instruction: Please summarize the update below in exactly three bullet points. Keep the dates and numbers unchanged, and do not add information.
payload: The pilot launched on 2 November 2026 with 120 users. Of those, 96 completed onboarding. Two payment bugs remain open. The next review is on 9 November 2026.
